# Runbook Template

Use this file as a starting point for production runbooks.

- Prefer deterministic, copy/paste-safe commands.
- Never include secrets/tokens.
- Assume the reader is tired and has partial context.

Start with: symptoms → first 5 minutes → triage → mitigations → rollback → escalation.

See `.github/skills/sre-oncall/templates/runbook-entry.template.md`.
